notes.title: The remastered version of the DLC update will be released at that time
notes.content:
Because the game art is too poor, the theme is not clear, and the plot is scattered. Also, it's too troublesome to use cocos creator to make RPG games. So I remade a galgame, hoping to solve the previous problem.
This time I upgraded my art (at least that's what I think), and my relatives say it's "really improved." I'm going to focus on polishing the story, gameplay, and graphics.

notes.title: DLC Update - True Ending content added
notes.content:
[h1] This time I added interaction with the computer, saving scene data, etc., and fixed a number of bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] The content of going to his aunt's house to repay the money: Zhiyuan smashed the door in the real ending, and he needs to do 250 yuan to repay the money
[*] [img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/36018046539c2b37f3869348c5dacdc92244e8c7.png[/img]
Interact with the computer: Turn on the computer after collecting the power supply and the computer, and you can watch a video. However, you need to get close to the table, and when an exclamation mark appears on your head, open the backpack and click on the computer and power supply in the inventory, and then put them in order to open it
[*] [img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/f6d4ff1cf1a4bf280bb7ddb81ddb5184bbdfcb2c.png[/img]
Save scene data: If checked, the objects of the game will be saved across scenes, and it is not recommended to enable it
[*] [img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/e15482ce9afb0b4637098a2435c72449ee968c28.png[/img]
[/list]
